searchText: Anyone can spare some goerli testnet ETH ? Here is my address: 0x322c3Eafbe33db974d545f6F472D66a9C24a9164 About 16 hours ago participation on prater suddenly jumped from 80% to 95%. Not sure what happened but it's a pretty amazing participation rate for a testnet. Probably rocketpool testers? Unless they'd previously registered validators and all coordinated to turn them on at the same time that seems unlikely. The participation just jumped up 15% in a single epoch.
